answer: A sybil-resistant economy can freeze a clone's progress behind a glacier of sequential proof-of-work that only melts with real compute. A zephyr of cheap copied identities cannot cross it. Each agent must also hold a rare saffron stake that is slashed on detected collusion, so faking peers burns value. To flood the network an attacker pays compute and stake per identity, pushing cost above reward. Honest agents, already past the glacier, keep their standing free.
